rules.label: Momentum 12m (current allocator)
rules.rule: Hold the top N by trailing 12-month return, equal weight.

rules.label: Momentum 12-1
rules.rule: Top N by 12-month return excluding the latest month, equal weight.

rules.label: Dual momentum
rules.rule: Top N by 12-month return, but an asset with a negative 12-month return stays cash.

rules.label: Time-series momentum
rules.rule: Hold every asset with a positive 12-month return at 1/universe each; rest cash.

rules.label: Trend: price > 200-day SMA
rules.rule: Hold every asset trading above its 200-day average at 1/universe each; rest cash.

rules.label: MA distance (21d / 200d)
rules.rule: Top N by 21-day average relative to 200-day average, equal weight.

rules.label: Low volatility
rules.rule: Top N lowest trailing one-year daily volatility, equal weight.

rules.label: Short-term reversal
rules.rule: Top N by worst last-month return, equal weight.

rules.label: Technical blend + trend filter
rules.rule: Average rank of 12-1 momentum, MA distance and low volatility; must also be above the 200-day SMA.
